info.description:
Amazon Inspector is a vulnerability discovery service that automates continuous scanning for security vulnerabilities within your Amazon EC2 and Amazon ECR environments.

Contact Support:
 Name: Mike Ralphson
 Email: mike.ralphson@gmail.com

request.description: Associates an Amazon Web Services account with an Amazon Inspector delegated administrator. An HTTP 200 response indicates the association was successfully started, but doesn’t indicate whether it was completed. You can check if the association completed by using ListMembers for multiple accounts or GetMembers for a single account.
